title: Jiemeng AI Launches Film Brand Jiemeng Studio S-Level Project Compute Credit Support
excerpt: Recently, Jiemeng AI officially launched the film and television content brand "Jiemeng Studio," offering support for long-form AI film and series projects to c
content_html:
Recently, Jiemeng AI officially launched the film and television content brand "Jiemeng Studio," offering support for long-form AI film and series projects to creators, promoting the upgrade of AIGC content from short videos to long-form film and television works.

In the film section, the project duration is recommended to be no less than 90 minutes, divided into S and A tiers of support. S-tier projects have full production credits covered with no limits, access to the highest computing power channels, and deep co-creation by the R&D team; A-tier projects can receive up to 250,000 credits per minute. Selected projects will also enjoy one-on-one guidance from technical teams, copyright protection, distribution resource connections, and festival submissions. Film projects adapted from Tofu Novel IP can also receive IP authorization and marketing resources support.

In the series section, each episode should be no less than 3 minutes, with a total length of about 100 minutes, and it offers three tiers of support: S, A, and B. S-tier provides full credit support and customized promotion plans; A-tier offers up to 200,000 credits per episode, along with distribution benefits and cash incentives for hit content; B-tier supports stable creation with tiered traffic and cash rewards.

In addition to long-form projects, Jiemeng also launched creator benefits such as the Creation Fund and Fengmang Huiyang. Short films can receive credits, DOU+, and cash rewards based on likes on Douyin. Those that become massive hits may even win significant creation funds and millions in promotional resources. Jiemeng Studio is building a complete chain from script development, production, to distribution and commercialization, continuously attracting high-quality AI film and television creation teams.
